# 集客整理帳

集客整理帳は、小規模店舗・小規模サービス向けに「今日やる1つ」「投稿案」「次回見ること」を約3分で整理する無料Webツールです。

## Main
- App: https://ai-o48s2t.v2.appdeploy.ai/
- Overview: https://koki-ai-ops.github.io/action-os-ultimate/shukyaku/
- About: https://koki-ai-ops.github.io/action-os-ultimate/shukyaku/about/
- FAQ: https://koki-ai-ops.github.io/action-os-ultimate/shukyaku/faq/

## Industries
- Restaurant: https://koki-ai-ops.github.io/action-os-ultimate/shukyaku/restaurant/
- Salon: https://koki-ai-ops.github.io/action-os-ultimate/shukyaku/salon/
- Retail: https://koki-ai-ops.github.io/action-os-ultimate/shukyaku/retail/
- Other services: https://koki-ai-ops.github.io/action-os-ultimate/shukyaku/service/

## Product facts
- Free beta
- No login
- No payment
- No external auto-posting
- User decisions stored locally in browser localStorage
- No fabricated PV, click, sales or outcome metrics
